title: Why Do Onions Make Us Cry? The Sneaky Tear Gas Trick!

lines.text: You're standing in the kitchen, Grandma slices an onion, and bam—you're crying!
lines.caps: You're standing in the *KITCHEN, | Grandma slices an onion, and *BAM— | you're *CRYING!

lines.text: Don't worry, you're not sad! The onion is actually defending itself!
lines.caps: Don't worry, you're not *SAD! | The onion is actually *DEFENDING | *ITSELF!

lines.text: Underground, onions don't want hungry moles and worms eating their bulb!
lines.caps: Underground, onions don't want *HUNGRY | worms eating their *BULB!

lines.text: When a knife slices the onion, tiny microscopic cells burst open!
lines.caps: When a knife slices the *ONION, | tiny microscopic cells *BURST | *OPEN!

lines.text: Sulfur compounds mix together to create an invisible cloud of tear gas!
lines.caps: Sulfur compounds *MIX | to create an invisible cloud of *TEAR | *GAS!

lines.text: When the gas touches your moist eyes, nerve sensors shout, Warning, irritant detected!
lines.caps: When the gas touches your *EYES, | nerve sensors shout, *WARNING! | Irritant *DETECTED!

lines.text: Your tear glands instantly pump a waterfall of fresh saline to wash it away!
lines.caps: Your tear glands *INSTANTLY | pump a waterfall of tears to *WASH | it *AWAY!

lines.text: Chef trick: Chill your onion in the fridge first to slow down the gas!
lines.caps: *CHEF TRICK: | Chill your onion in the *FRIDGE | to slow down the *GAS!
